name: credential_pool_parse_absolute_timestamp
notes: Epoch-seconds/ms/ISO-8601 reset-timestamp parse. C port credential_pool_ports.c::cpl_parse_absolute_timestamp traced as faithful copy; twin calls LIVE _parse_absolute_timestamp and traces the same rung ladder (float-parse / ms-divide / ISO). None encoded as -1 sentinel on both sides; %.17g value parity. DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCES (inputs excluded): (1) non-positive numerics: LIVE returns None, C returns the value (no <=0 guard in C port — real gap worth a follow-up); (2) naive ISO strings without TZ: LIVE uses local-time .timestamp(), C timegm — only Z-suffixed ISO exercised where both are UTC; (3) whitespace-padded numerics like '  42  ': LIVE float() strips, C strtod requires full consumption so trailing space falls through to None — dropped.
